import qs from 'query-string'; import SoundFont from '/src/index'; /** sf2synth.js Option */ const options = Object.assign( { // URL to SoundFont File sf: 'Yamaha XG Sound Set.sf2', // Show Keyboard ui: true, // Target dom id placeholder: 'placeholder', // Color Mode (auto, dark, light) colorMode: 'auto', }, qs.parse(window.location.search) ); document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', event => { /** @type {HTMLInputElement} File Input Form */ const fileInput = document.getElementById('file'); /** @type {HTMLDivElement} drag area */ const dragArea = document.getElementById('drag'); /** @type {HTMLTimeElement} Build Date */ const build = document.getElementById('build'); /** @type {HTMLInputElement} */ const toggleDarkMode = document.getElementById('toggleDarkMode'); /** @type {string} SoundFont file */ const sf = decodeURIComponent(options.sf); document.getElementById('soundfont').innerText = sf; // Apply build time build.dateTime = SoundFont.build; build.innerText = new Date(SoundFont.build).toLocaleString(); /** WebMidiLink */ const wml = new SoundFont.WebMidiLink(options); wml.setLoadCallback(() => { dragArea.classList.remove('bg-info'); }); wml.setup(sf); // Keep an eye out for System Light/Dark Mode Changes const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'); mediaQuery.addListener(() => { // Ignore change if there's an override set if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')) { return; } // Apply color mode. wml.setColorMode(options.colorMode); // Make sure the checkbox is up-to-date toggleDarkMode.checked = mediaQuery.matches; }); /** * Load sound font * * @param {File} file */ const handleSoundFont = file => { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file); reader.onload = e => { document.getElementById('soundfont').innerText = file.name; const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result); wml.setupByBuffer(data); }; }; // When select SoundFont file fileInput.addEventListener( 'change', event => { event.preventDefault(); handleSoundFont(fileInput.files[0]); fileInput.value = ''; }, false ); // When SoundFont Drag and Drop. dragArea.addEventListener( 'drop', event => { const dt = event.dataTransfer; if (dt.files.length) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); handleSoundFont(dt.files[0]); } dragArea.classList.remove('bg-info'); }, false ); dragArea.addEventListener( 'dragover', event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); dragArea.classList.add('bg-info'); }, false ); dragArea.addEventListener( 'dragleave', event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); dragArea.classList.remove('bg-info'); }, false ); // Toggle Dark mode toggleDarkMode.addEventListener('change', e => { wml.setColorMode(e.target.checked ? 'dark' : 'light'); }); }, false );
